author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the past, when two teams coded a similar tool, it guaranteed a turf war of survival.  No one is willing to give up the code created by their hard work.    

In the AI era, everyone vibe code, we don't have any attachment to the code anymore.  If two teams coded a similar idea, it is easy to refactor the two code bases into one, keeping the best from both.

We can focus on the requirements and technical trade off, not fighting for ownership.
